period.static_features: September 2026 OSM inventory used as an explicitly estimated static surrogate for this period; historical road changes are not reconstructed.
period.dynamic_features: Historical provider weather records plus date/hour-specific traffic estimates; not 8760 independent traffic observations.
period.flood_risk: Static mapped NOAH hazard exposure proxy, not observed hourly flooding.

calibration_split.note: Declare chronological, non-overlapping ISO dates within the study period. Weights, scales, class summaries and profiles are fitted on development only; tuning freezes search budgets; test is held out for the comparison. Unset boundaries block calibration and routing.

distance.local_evidence: L = WGS84 geodesic length of the OSM geometry in km; the 2026 map is a temporal surrogate.
distance.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

congestion.local_evidence: L x g, where g = 1 - 1/(1 + 0.15*x^4) per road segment and hour from data/processed/temporal/traffic_hourly.csv and x is a seeded, assumed demand-to-capacity index (hourly profile, road-type factor, weekend factor, repeatable daily per-city, three-hour per-area, static per-road and three-hour per-road variation). Project assumptions, not measurements, vehicle counts or independently estimated demand.
congestion.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

travel_time.local_evidence: T (min) = free-flow time x BPR travel-time factor of the same assumed scenario x assumed weather multiplier. Posted OSM speed is only a free-flow proxy; fallback speeds are assumptions.
travel_time.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

intersections.local_evidence: I = 1 when the segment's downstream node has OSM street_count >= 3: one encounter per traversed approach; geometry vertices are not nodes. Current topology is a temporal surrogate.
intersections.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

signals.local_evidence: S = 1 when the downstream node has an OSM traffic_signals tag: one encounter per traversed approach. Missing tags are assumed absent, not confirmed absent.
signals.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

road_type.local_evidence: L x p, p_k = 1 - median free-flow speed of OSM class k / the largest class median over development roads. A stated preference for faster classes, not a published penalty.
road_type.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

time_profile.local_evidence: L x h, h = mean congestion of the road's group (city x road type) for the day category (weekday/weekend) and local hour over development dates only; falls back to road type, then all roads. The clock hour itself is not a penalty.
time_profile.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

weather.local_evidence: L x a, a = assumed severity of the hourly category from the nearest 0.05-degree provider grid (1-hour precipitation: >= 7.5 mm heavy rain, > 0 rain). Kept separate from flood exposure. Severities and speed multipliers are assumptions, not calibrated.
weather.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

flood_exposure.local_evidence: Sum over portions of km inside each NOAH five-year hazard class x assumed class severity (class/3 scenario; alternatives equal and convex). Overlaps resolve to the highest class. Mapped susceptibility, not current inundation or closure; no bridge elevation correction.
flood_exposure.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

capacity_burden.local_evidence: L / K, K = directional lanes x assumed 1,900 veh/h/lane base saturation flow x g/C (0.5 assumed at a mapped signal, else 1). Inverse capacity is a provisional study mapping, not a universal published road penalty; lanes and signal timings are unvalidated.
capacity_burden.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

note: Release readiness means the disclosed estimation pipeline is operational, not that historical traffic was measured or estimates calibrated.
